title: Maintenance
intro: Maintenance mode locks everyone out except administrators, so you can back up or restore without anyone changing the data. A job that is already running finishes first. The setting survives a restart.

state.draining: Waiting for the running job to finish. Everyone else is already locked out.
state.on: Maintenance mode is on. Only administrators can use the server.

reasonPlaceholder: For example: Restoring a backup, back in about an hour
confirmOn: This locks out every other user now. Continue?
cli: On the host, with the API running or stopped: python -m mosaicwave.maintenance on, off or status.

banner.on: Maintenance mode is on. Only administrators can use mosaicWave.
banner.draining: Maintenance mode is starting. Waiting for the running job to finish.

screen.title: Down for maintenance
screen.lede: mosaicWave is being looked after and will be back soon.
screen.noReason: The administrator has not given a reason.
